message.Title: Generally Available: Cloud-native apps on Kubernetes pricing calculator scenario

Body.Content:
The new cloud-native apps on Kubernetes pricing calculator scenario allows teams to estimate the total cost of ownership for a production-ready AKS cluster with other key Azure services, including Azure Container Registry, Azure Monitoring, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, and more. The calculator scenario provides an architecture diagram and cost estimate with customizable inputs to fit your workload requirements. Whether you are migrating legacy workloads or deploying new applications, including microservices, web apps, AI, GPU workloads, and databases, this calculator scenario will help you establish your cost baseline. 

Learn more.
